draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 29th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 20 at RB. He went 46th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jamaal Charles. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,139 rushing yards in 2023, 6th of 20 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers (reserve). 3 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 0 AV in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (4th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 45 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, below the norm.
